title: Update on Interagency Taskforce on Mental Health and Well-being and Programmes to Improve Mental Health Literacy
what_it_is: Update on Interagency Taskforce on Mental Health and Well-being and Programmes to Improve Mental Health Literacy

sections.label: Mental health task force consultation
sections.summary: The task force is consulting the public from 30 May to 7 August 2022 on 12 preliminary recommendations in three focus areas, to refine them and develop a national mental health strategy.

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: The task force is currently embarking on a consultation exercise from 30 May 2022 to 7 August 2022 to seek the views of the public on its preliminary recommendations.

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: The findings from the public consultation will enable the task force to refine the recommendations and develop a national strategy on mental health and well-being.

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: Following this, indicators will be developed to measure the implementation progress and effectiveness of the strategy.

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: The task force has proposed 12 preliminary recommendations in three focus areas.

sections.label: Mental health service recommendations
sections.summary: Recommendations include designating first-stop touchpoints, standardising processes between social and healthcare providers, and equipping frontline providers with mental health knowledge and competencies.

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: Some of the recommendations include designating first-stop touchpoints for easier wayfinding of mental health services, standardising process and systems between social and healthcare providers for better coordination of care and equipping frontline service providers with the relevant mental health knowledge and competencies to support their clients.

sections.label: Whole mental health strategy approach
sections.summary: The task force says it is looking at the entire strategy, including resource deployment, professional training, client referral across the ecosystem, and healthcare and social care relationships.

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: The task force is not planning only on raising literacy and providing education.

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: We are looking at the entire strategy and the way in which we approach the deployment of resources, training of professionals, referral of clients across the ecosystem as well as the relationship between the healthcare and social care parts of our mental health infrastructure.

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: Within that space, there will be a need to look at the allocation of resources and the deployment of personnel.

sections.label: Live Well, Age Well programme
sections.summary: The MOH-funded Live Well, Age Well programme, jointly implemented by HPB and the People's Association, augments seniors' programmes with a mental well-being focus; over 13,000 unique seniors participated in 2021.

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: Another example would be the "Live Well, Age Well" programme, which is funded by MOH and jointly implemented by HPB and the People's Association, to augment existing seniors' programmes with a focus on mental well-being.

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: More than 13,000 unique seniors participated in the programme in 2021.

sections.label: Wider networks for seniors' mental health
sections.summary: The speaker says a wider spread of nodes, networks, community organisations, and healthcare and social care communities is needed to support seniors' mental health needs.

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: I hope that is not what she was characterising the situation as.

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: We really do need a wider surface area, a wider spread of nodes, networks, the community organisations, the healthcare community as well as the social care community to participate in that response to support the mental health needs of our seniors.
